data.narrative:
Andromeda Surgical is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Nick Damiano and Kartik Tiwari that has raised $10M+. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers, though meaningful peer-median triangulation was precluded by insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum data density thresholds.

The Stage-Progression method is the primary applicable framework, using total capital raised ($10M+) as a proxy for current value ($35M) and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage funding rounds, yielding an implied valuation of $88M. Public comps in the sector trade at a median P/S of 9.2x, but this approach cannot be deployed given the absence of disclosed revenue for Andromeda.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $74M–$101M, centered at $88M. Key uncertainties include the precise quantum of capital deployed (range given as "$10M+"), the timing and definition of the next funding event (which drives multiplier sensitivity), and the absence of financial metrics to anchor to public trading multiples. The single-method reliance reflects data constraints inherent to early-stage private biotechnology rather than analytical consensus across multiple triangulation approaches.
